displayPattern: Front-load washer display shows F8 E2 (select models)
meaning: Dispenser system problem: the detergent drawer or detergent cartridge may be clogged.
causes: Detergent drawer or cartridge clogged with detergent
diySteps: Check that the detergent drawer or detergent cartridge is not clogged with detergent and clean it (Whirlpool has a separate "How do I clean my washer dispensers?" guide)
safetyNote: Unplug the washer (or switch off its breaker) and close the water taps before you reach behind it, handle hoses or open a filter. Water left from a recent hot cycle can be very hot, so let it cool first. Never bypass the door lock. Motor, pump, valve, sensor and control-board repairs belong to a qualified appliance technician.
proAdvice: If F8 E2 returns after cleaning, contact Whirlpool or schedule service online.
sourceTitle: Error Codes in Front Load Washers (Whirlpool Product Help)
